# Backup

*solution* · status **approved** · owner home lab admin · [all SAs](../README.md)

Nightly restic snapshots of Nextcloud data and the database, copied off-site. Approved change (ADR-0001): move the off-site copy from Backblaze B2 to a Hetzner Storage Box.
